//: The build, as one command. Every entry point in the `exports` map is referenced here, plus `./src/dom`, which is not one — nothing in the map reaches it, and `./react` and `./vue` each re-export every public name it holds. `tsc -b` works out the order from the references rather than from a chain of `&&` in package.json that a reader has to trust. `files: []` because this config compiles nothing itself — it only says what the package is made of.
